title: ARI-RQGM transition event (one line of rqgm_transitions.jsonl)
description: The hash-chained, append-only line envelope (docs/plans/ari_rqgm/02 §5.6/§6). event_hash = hash12(canonical_json(payload)); prev_event_hash chains to the previous line ('' for the first). ts/ts_iso are metadata OUTSIDE the hashed payload (P2). rqgm_audit.jsonl reuses this exact envelope with an independent per-file chain; its governance payload schemas are owned by Tasks 05/06. Local $defs are byte-equal copies of rqgm_defs.schema.json (pinned by tests).
